chapters.title: Prologue: Is it Stuffy In Here?
chapters.description: Lex continues his daily workout with Stuffy!

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Hey Hey Diddle
chapters.description: Hot on the tales of Mother Goose and the Big Bad Wolf, Lex finds himself up against nursery nasties with a serious case of the grumps!

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Old MacDonald Owns a Farm
chapters.description: Lex follows the sound of Mother Goose's voice but takes a wrong turn through a hotly contested homestead!

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Pigs v. Wolves
chapters.description: Reluctantly pointed towards the ferocious Big Bad Wolf by recalcitrant porcines, Lex races to save Mother Goose from a fate worse than soup!

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Lex Be Nimble
chapters.description: Mother Goose joins Lex in his perilous quest, but even she can't protect him from being mistaken for a roguish Jack-of-all-trades.

chapters.title: Chapter 5: GoldieLex and 3 Bears
chapters.description: Hungry and needing provisions, Lex investigates a homey cabin from which wafts the unmistakable scent of fresh-made porridge!

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Forgotten Forest
chapters.description: Hopelessly lacking directions in a darkened forest, our heroes stumble across a breadcrumb trail leading to a deliciously dangerous destiny!

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Caterpillar's Lair
chapters.description: Beckoned down the rabbit hole by the mysterious Cat, Lex and Mother Goose find themselves facing a fuming foe whose powerful puffs take on lives of their own!

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Tea Party
chapters.description: Our heroes, joined now by the Cheshire Cat, press on in their search for the Queen only to encounter a furiously festive feast where jeopardy is served steaming hot!

chapters.title: Chapter 9: Behind the Looking Glass
chapters.description: Castle Wonderland looms in the near distance as our brave adventurers battle through a mimsy borogove stocked with oddball duos and a whiffling burbler with eyes of flame!

chapters.title: Chapter 10: Castle Wonderland
chapters.description: Desperate for answers and confused beyond reason, Lex and his companions struggle to get through to a Queen of Hearts deeply immersed in important matters of state.

chapters.title: Chapter 1: A Child's Nightmare
chapters.description: Swept into a bizarre realm by the power of the Rift, Lex and his friends struggle in the grip of a long-buried terror.

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Men of Low Character
chapters.description: Lex and his companions have escaped the nightmare claws of the Elder Tiger, but now they face a procession of ill-humored acolytes who never met a vow they didn't break!

chapters.title: Chapter 3: Imperial Entanglement
chapters.description: Fighting their way past the corrupted monks, our adventurous trio stumbles into a field of battle where wicked troops find themselves grossly overmatched!

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Years of Training
chapters.description: Master Wong of martial arts fame has agreed to lend Lex his aid. But Lex has a lot to learn and his education must begin in earnest!

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Temple Haunt
chapters.description: Surging with powerful kung-fu, Lex is ready to press on. A nearby cursed temple holds passage to the spirit world, and our heroes have no choice but to challenge the horrors that reside within.

chapters.title: Chapter 6: Under the Sea
chapters.description: The mysterious Monkey King could be a powerful ally to Lex and his friends. Tracking him down, however, will not be easy as our heroes pursue the rogue into a deep domain of watery peril!

chapters.title: Chapter 7: The Monkey King
chapters.description: The pursuers become the confronted as the Monkey King demands the Dragon King's Iron Rod. Can Lex win Monkey's loyalty? There's only one way to impress the wily demigod: defeat him in battle!

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Heck Dimension
chapters.description: Bound as battlemates, Lex and his courageous crew descend to the darkest pits of existence for their most incredible challenge yet: release innocent monkeys' souls from the clutches of death!

chapters.title: Chapter 9: The Gates of Heaven
chapters.description: Grateful and eager to help, the Monkey King leads Lex to the doorway to nirvana. These gates do not open lightly, though, and Lex must wrack both brain and soul to enter these hallowed realms!

chapters.title: Chapter 10: The Celestial Realm
chapters.description: Beings of unknowable power and ancient judgment reside in the highest planes. Can Lex prove his worthiness to them and earn passage back to the Library to confront his nemesis?

chapters.title: Chapter 1: Space Traveling
chapters.description: Commandeering a skelebot flier, Lex's band races across a universe towards a lost, forbidding planet!

chapters.title: Chapter 2: Wasteful Land
chapters.description: Emerging essentially unhurt from the flier crash, our heroes cast their gaze across a vast wake of bleakness, a dry, pitless realm inhabited only by twisted parodies of life!

chapters.title: Chapter 3: The Time Device
chapters.description: Beckoned onward by Herbert's enigmatic note, our friends delve deep into a cavernous realm at the very end of time!

chapters.title: Chapter 4: Robots, Robots, Robots
chapters.description: Herbert George Wells, writer, real person and inventor, joins the party and directs them deeper down into a steelclad base burgeoning with robots from throughout time!

chapters.title: Chapter 5: Back to the Library
chapters.description: Determined to forestall EviLex's vile theft of Codex's Magic Pen, our valiant crew blasts back in time to undo all the troubles before they even began!

chapters.title: Chapter 6: The Sound of Lightning
chapters.description: Lex and his friends have reacquired Codex's Magic Pen but lost a villain: EviLex! Hustling against time, they dart back to the Sci-Fi world to fix the unknown reverberations of damage.

chapters.title: Chapter 7: Robots 2: Electric Boogaloo
chapters.description: After an unexpected stop in the past, Lex & Co. bop to the future-present of the Sci-Fi world to make sure everything is okay. What they discover, however, lies beyond their wildest imaginings...

chapters.title: Chapter 8: Virtually a World
chapters.description: Skeletrox, or at least his head, is beaten, battered and thoroughly reprogrammed to help the forces of good. With his help the team forges forward into a computerized zone of digital danger!

chapters.title: Chapter 9: Worst Dystopia Ever
chapters.description: Emerging from the kingdom of ones and zeroes, our valiant comrades gird themselves to face Skeltrox's older brother and his horrific, soul-destroying plans for the entirety of existence!

chapters.title: Chapter 10: The Machine
chapters.description: Bigger Brother and all his works lie in ruins yet his Machine pulses with reality-crushing energy! Can Lex's literary legion add their power to his in time to forestall a multiverse-shattering explosion?
